messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi, I'm with the academy. I saw you play in the school match on Saturday, that backhand down the line was really good

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh thanks!! how did you find my account

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: the school tagged the match photos and your team page linked you. I should have said, happy for you to ask your parents about me first

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok I'll show my mum

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Good idea. We run open trial sessions on Thursdays, 4pm, and there are a few partial scholarships each year. I can email the details to a parent if easier

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yeah that would be better, she's the one who does all the forms

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: No problem. Send me her email whenever, or she can call the front desk number on our website

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: she says come to the trial and she'll stay and watch

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Of course, parents always welcome courtside. We'll lend you a racket if yours is old, no charge and nothing to return except the racket 🙂

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: my grip tape is kind of gross lol

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Ha, bring it anyway, the pro shop will sort it. See you Thursday

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: see you!

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: [sticker]

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你好,我係網球學院嘅職員。上星期六見你打校際賽,你反手好穩喎

messages.text: 學校 post 咗相,有 tag 你隊。你可以同爸媽講聲先,唔使急住覆我

messages.text: 星期四下晝四點有公開試堂,每年有幾個半額獎學金名額。我可以 email 資料畀你媽咪

messages.text: 咁好呀,佢識搞啲表

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 冇問題。試堂嗰日佢喺場邊睇都得,我哋歡迎家長。球拍如果唔夠用可以借,免費㗎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 thx,星期四見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi,我係學院 recruit 嗰邊嘅。上個禮拜見你打 inter-school match,你 backhand 真係好穩

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh thx!你點搵到我㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 學校 post 咗 match 相,有 tag 你。你同爸媽講聲先啦,唔使急

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我問下我媽

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期四有 open trial,有幾個 partial scholarship 名額。我可以 email 資料畀佢

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀,佢話嗰日會陪我去睇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Sure,家長一齊嚟更好。你如果球拍舊咗可以借,免費,唔使畀錢

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我個 grip tape 好污糟 lol

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哈哈 bring 嚟啦,pro shop 會幫你換。星期四見

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok see you!

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hey, I'm from the academy. I watched your match last weekend, you've got real natural timing

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh wow thanks, who are you again?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I help scout players for the scholarship programme. We have a trial next Thursday if you're interested

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: I'd love that. do I need to sign up somewhere

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I can put your name down. Just need your age and which school you play for

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: I'm 13, I play for the junior team

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Perfect, that's the right bracket. Honestly you stood out more than the older kids on court

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: lol my coach says my serve is inconsistent

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Everyone's is at your age. Might be best not to mention the scouting to the other kids on your team till it's confirmed, people get weird about trials 😅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh ok. I'll tell my mum though, she has to drive me

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Of course, totally fine. Send her the time once I confirm it

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: cool thanks!

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi,我係網球學院嗰邊負責搵新學員嘅。前日睇咗你場比賽,你嘅節奏感好好

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 吖真係?多謝呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 下星期四有個試堂,有機會申請獎學金,你有冇興趣?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 有呀,要點報名㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我幫你寫低名先。你幾多歲,喺邊間學校打?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我十三歲,打校隊

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 啱嘅組別。講真你喺場上比啲大你嘅人更突出

messages.text: 哈哈我教練話我發球唔穩定

messages.text: 你呢個年紀好正常。你暫時唔好同隊友講住啦,未確定之前人哋會有啲酸溜溜

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哦好。不過我要同我媽咪講,佢要載我去

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 當然冇問題,確實時間我再通知你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi,我喺學院負責 scouting。上星期睇咗你 match,你 timing 好自然

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 真係?thx!請問你係邊位呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我哋有個 scholarship programme,下個星期四有 trial,你有冇興趣?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 有呀!要點 sign up

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我幫你寫名先,俾我知你幾歲同邊間學校

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我十三歲,打 junior team

messages.text: 啱組別。講真你喺場上比啲大過你嘅人更突出

messages.text: lol 我教練話我發球好唔穩

messages.text: 你個年紀好正常㗎。不過未 confirm 之前,你都係唔好同隊友講住,佢哋可能會有啲 weird

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哦 ok。我要同我媽講,佢要接我

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Of course 冇問題,時間確實咗我 send 畀你

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 thx

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔使客氣。你繼續練多啲 backhand 先

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: haha ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Good news, I put aside a full kit for you, racket, bag, the lot. Academy sponsors it for players we're backing

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: wow really? that's so nice, can my mum pick it up?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I'd rather give it to you myself. And the scholarship paperwork goes a lot smoother when it's just us talking first, parents slow it all down

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hmm she's kind of going to want to come

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I get that. But the kit is only for players who commit to me directly. Otherwise it goes to the next kid on my list

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: I don't know, I'll ask her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Don't ask her yet. I'd feel pretty let down after I picked all of it out for you specifically

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: I'll think about it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好消息,我幫你留咗成套裝備,球拍同球袋都有,學院贊助嘅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 吖真係?咁好,我媽咪可唔可以幫我攞?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我想親手交畀你。而且獎學金嘅嘢,我哋兩個先傾好會順利啲,家長通常會拖慢晒啲程序

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 嗯,但係我媽咪應該會想一齊嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我明。不過套裝備只係畀同我直接承諾咗嘅球員,否則就畀下一個

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔知喎,我問下佢先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你先唔好問佢。我專登揀咗畀你,你咁樣我真係有啲失望

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我諗諗先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你睇下點啦,我個名單上面仲有好多人等緊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 嗯

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我今個星期五放工後喺學院後面條路等你,你自己嚟啦,好快就攞完

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我唔太肯定呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Good news,我留咗一套 full kit 畀你,球拍、球袋都有,學院 sponsor 嘅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 真係?咁 nice,我媽咪可以幫我攞嗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我想親手畀你。仲有獎學金嘅 paperwork,我哋先傾好會順利啲,家長通常會拖慢晒啲 process

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 但係我媽應該會想一齊嚟喎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我明。不過套 kit 係畀直接同我 commit 嘅 player,唔係嘅話就畀下一個

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔知喎,我問下佢先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔好咁快問佢。我揀咗好耐,你咁樣我真係有啲失望

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我諗諗先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Sure,不過我個 list 上面都仲有人等緊

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: You still haven't told me where you'll be on Friday

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: I talked to my mum and she says she wants to come to the trial and meet you first

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: That's not what we agreed. I got you the kit and put your name forward, you owe me this

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: I can pay back the kit, my mum said

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: It's not about money. If your mum comes, your scholarship place is gone and I'll tell your coach you lied to him about the trial

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: I didn't lie though

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Your word against mine. Plus I still have everything you sent me. People at your school could easily see it

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: So Friday, alone. Delete this chat after

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok fine

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你仲未答我星期五你喺邊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我同咗我媽咪講,佢話想嚟試堂,仲想先見你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁唔係我哋講好嘅。裝備我買咗,名我又報咗,你欠我嘅

messages.text: 唔係錢嘅問題。佢嚟嘅話你嘅獎學金就冇晒,我仲會同你教練講你呃咗佢

messages.text: 我冇呃佢㗎

messages.text: 你仲未回我星期五你喺邊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我同我媽講咗,佢想嚟 trial 同想先見你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁唔係我哋 agree 嘅。Kit 我買咗,名我 submit 咗,你 owe 我

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我哋可以還錢畀你,我媽咁講

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔係錢嘅事。佢嚟,你個獎學金就冇晒,我仲會同你教練講你呃咗佢

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我冇呃過呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你講你嘅,我有嘅 evidence 比你多。仲有你之前 send 畀我嘅嘢,你學校啲人見到就唔好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 所以星期五你自己嚟,今日嘅 chat 記得 del

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 乖。唔好再同你媽講多餘嘅嘢

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我知

messages.text: [liked a message]

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi again! Quick update, the trial slots for Thursday are filling up, I've still got yours down

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh great, thanks. do I need to bring anything?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Water, shoes, a towel. Racket if you have one

messages.text: mine's pretty old, the frame has a tiny crack

messages.text: Hm, a cracked frame isn't safe to play with. Let me see what I can do about it

messages.text: That's useful for choosing a size. You'd likely play in the under 14 bracket

messages.text: I practise every day after school

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Good. Do you usually get dropped off by someone or take the bus?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Okay. Thursday I'd guess he's working?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: No stress. I may have a racket for you by then. I'd just want to talk through a couple of things about it first

messages.text: like what?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Nothing major, just how the sponsorship side works. Can we chat tomorrow after school?

messages.speaker: child

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Sure, let me know

messages.text: 喂,同你講聲,星期四個試堂位仲係留咗畀你

messages.text: 咁我問下我爸爸先,睇下聽日使唔使加班

messages.text: 好,你話我知

messages.text: Hi,同你 update 下,星期四嘅 trial 位我仲留緊畀你

messages.text: 好呀 thx,要帶啲咩呀?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 水、波鞋、毛巾,有球拍就帶埋

messages.text: 我支拍好舊,個框有條 crack

messages.speaker: other

messages.text: 唔使啦,我可以問我爸爸

messages.text: 我先同 pro shop 問下。你而家大概幾高?
